text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we've got it cornered!
Here we go! Haa...
Wah!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし追い詰めたっ！
それじゃあいくよー！　
はああ……
わあっ！？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
...Ouch... I got hit.
What was with that earlier, were they going easy on us!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
っつー……
食らっちゃった。
なんだよ
さっきのは手加減してたの！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
This monster is stronger than before!?
Iroha-chan are you alri──!?
Sono-san... that magic power...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この魔物
さっきより強くなってる！？
イロハちゃん
大丈──っ！？
ソノさん……
その魔力……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text:
...I'm usually all about energy saving.
Trying hard is tiring and a hassle, but...
Even so.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私は基本省エネでさ。
頑張るの疲れるし
だるいけど。
……それでも。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Can I stay silent when my niece is being attacked...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 姪がやられて黙ってられるかってのよ……！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text:
You're not giving that up, huh?
...Alright, let's go!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこは譲らないのね。
……よし、
いくわよ！！
